description: Yıllara Göre Ölümlü Yaralanmalı Trafik Kaza Sayısı is a dataset listed in Istanbul Metropolitan Municipality open data portal, a city open data portal (CKAN), published or maintained by TÜİK. Bu veri seti İstanbul ve Türkiye düzeyinde yıllara ve yerleşim bölgelerine göre ölümlü-yaralanmalı trafik kaza verilerini içermektedir. Coverage: TÜİK. The publisher named on the listing is TÜİK. Its keywords include kaza, trafik, trafik kazası, yaralanma, ölüm. The listing shows 1 download or service links in XLS. The listing shows 2025-12-17 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Istanbul Metropolitan Municipality Open Data License. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-data-ibb-gov-tr.
